description: Generic Sega Master System game profile. Two face buttons (1 south, 2 east) plus a Pause button (start). Pause is on the console rather than the controller on real hardware; libretro maps it to the Start joypad slot.

confirm.hint: Press 2. Primary action in most SMS games; advance menus.

cancel.hint: Press 1. Secondary action (jump in platformers, alternate attack in others).

pause.hint: Press the Pause button on the console. SMS has no menu UI; this only pauses gameplay.

nav_up.hint: Walk / move up. In menus: cursor up.

nav_down.hint: Walk / move down. In menus: cursor down.

nav_left.hint: Walk / move left. In menus: cursor left.

nav_right.hint: Walk / move right. In menus: cursor right.

notes: Most SMS games use button 1 for jump and button 2 for attack/shoot. The convention is genre-dependent enough that confirm/cancel here are best treated as 'primary' and 'secondary' rather than strict menu verbs.
